title: scNMT-seq
author: Stephen Clark
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6jnhcme

Plate on magnet until beads pellet. Remove supernatent.
In a thermocycler incubate as follows: 55 °C 00:05:00 , 4 °C, pause
Tranfer samples to fresh 96w PCR plate.

steps.title: Single Cell Collection and Lysis
steps.instruction: Collect single cells in 2.5 µL of freshly prepared GpC methylase reaction mix (kept on ice).

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at ≥1000g for ≥10s.
Incubate on a thermocycler at 37 °C for 15 minutes.
Add 5 µL RLT plus and centrifuge at ≥1000g for ≥10s.
Store at -80 °C if not proceeding immediately.

steps.title: Prepare Oligo-dT Beads
steps.instruction: Prepare biotinylated oligo-dT beads for mRNA capture.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 55 µL Dynabeads (MyOne Streptavidin C1) into a microcentrifuge tube, place on a magnet, and remove supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 55 µL solution A (0.1M NaOH, 0.05M NaCl), place on magnet, and remove supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 55 µL solution B (0.1M NaCl), place on magnet, and remove supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 55 µL 2x B&W (2 M NaCl, 10 mM Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA), place on magnet, and remove supernatant.
Resuspend beads in 55 µL 2x B&W and 55 µL bio-Smartseq2-dT (100uM; 5'-Biotin-TEG-AAGCAGTGGTATCAACGCAGAGTACTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTTVN-3').
Rotate tube for at least 15 minutes to keep beads in solution.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, and resuspend in 110 µL 1x B&W buffer (1M NaCl, 5mM Tris, 0.5mM EDTA).
Place on magnet and remove supernatant.

steps.title: mRNA Capture and gDNA Separation
steps.instruction: Capture mRNA using the prepared beads and separate it from the genomic DNA (gDNA).

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in a mixture of 860 µL Nuclease free water, 220 µL 5x first strand buffer (Invitrogen, Superscript II), 28 µL RNasin (Promega), and 10 µL diluted ERCC spike-in (optional).
Manually pipette 10 µL of these prepared oligo-dT beads into each well of the sample plate.
Mix at maximum speed (or intermittent vortexing) for 10 minutes.
Place on magnet until beads pellet.
Aspirate 17.5 µL of the supernatant and transfer to an empty lobind plate for gDNA collection.
Add 15 µL of G&T-seq wash buffer off the magnet.
Mix at maximum speed (or thorough vortexing) for 1 minute.
Place on magnet until beads pellet, aspirate 15 µL, and transfer to the gDNA plate. Repeat this wash 3 times in total (total 17.5 µL lysate + 45 µL wash).
gDNA can be frozen at -20 °C.

steps.title: First Strand cDNA Synthesis
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription on the captured mRNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 µL RT mastermix to the beads and mix at maximum speed for 1 minute.
Incubate on a thermocycler: 42 °C for 1 hour, 50 °C for 30 minutes, and 60 °C for 10 minutes. Vortex the plate at the 30 and 60 minute marks to resuspend beads.
Add 12 µL PCR mastermix by hand using a multichannel pipette.
Run PCR cycling: 98 °C for 3 minutes; then 18 cycles of (98 °C for 20s, 67 °C for 15s, 72 °C for 6 minutes); followed by 72 °C for 5 minutes. Pause at 4 °C (usually overnight).
cDNA can be frozen at -20 °C.

steps.title: cDNA Purification and Quality Control
steps.instruction: Purify the synthesized cDNA (performed outside pre-PCR room).

substeps.instruction: Add 18 µL AMPure XP beads, mix thoroughly, and incubate for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet until beads pellet, remove supernatant, and wash twice with 100 µL 80% ethanol.
Remove supernatant and immediately resuspend in 10 µL nuclease free water.
Elute cDNA in 25 µL water.
Check quality of a subset (e.g., 11 samples) using Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity DNA chip (expected: 1kb-5kb, 100-500 pg/µL). Dilute with water if concentration is too high.

steps.title: Bisulfite Conversion of gDNA
steps.instruction: Convert unmethylated cytosines to uracils in the collected gDNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 50 µL AMPure XP beads to gDNA samples, vortex thoroughly, and incubate for 30 minutes.
Place on magnet to pellet beads.
Prepare CT Conversion Reagent: Mix 7.9 mL M-Solubilization Buffer and 3 mL M-Dilution Buffer with CT Conversion Reagent (vortex/shake for 10 mins), then add 1.6 mL M-Reaction Buffer and vortex.
Add 65 µL of prepared CT Conversion Reagent to each sample on the magnet (do not mix; beads must remain pelleted).
Incubate on thermocycler: 98 °C for 8 minutes, 64 °C for 3 hours, then hold at 4 °C (max overnight).

steps.title: gDNA Purification and Desulphonation
steps.instruction: Purify the bisulfite-converted DNA and remove sulfonates.

substeps.instruction: Prepare binding beads: Add 533 µL Zymo Magbinding beads to 32 mL M-Binding buffer; dispense 305 µL per well of a deepwell plate.
Add sample to the deepwell plate, mix thoroughly, transfer 100 µL back to sample plate, mix, and transfer back to deepwell plate. Mix for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, and add 180 µL 80% ethanol. Mix thoroughly.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, and add 100 µL M-Desulphonation buffer (Zymo). Mix thoroughly.
Incubate for 15 to 25 minutes.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, and add 180 µL 80% ethanol. Mix thoroughly.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, and dry beads at 60 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Bisulfite-cDNA Library Construction
steps.instruction: Perform primer extension and amplification of the converted gDNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend beads in 20 µL first strand synthesis mix (containing first strand oligo: /5SpC3/CTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATCTNNNNNN) and incubate at 60 °C for 5 minutes.
Place on magnet, transfer 20 µL supernatant to a fresh lobind PCR plate.
Incubate plate at 65 °C for 3 minutes, then immediately cool on ice.
Add 1 µL Klenow exo- (50 U/µL, Enzymatics).
Incubate: 4 °C for 5 minutes, slow ramp to 37 °C (15s per 1 °C), 37 °C for 30 minutes, then 4 °C hold.
Heat to 95 °C for 45 seconds, then immediately cool to 4 °C using ice blocks.
Add 2.5 µL first-strand extra cycles mix (with first strand oligo).
Purify: Add 70 µL AMPure XP beads per well in a deepwell plate, transfer 100 µL sample, mix, and incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, add 180 µL 80% ethanol, mix, and remove supernatant after pelleting.
Resuspend beads in 49 µL second strand master mix (containing second strand oligo: TGCTGAACCGCTCTTCCGATCTNNNNNN).
Transfer mix with beads to a fresh 96w PCR plate and incubate at 98 °C for 2 minutes, then cool on ice.
Add 0.5 µL Klenow exo- (50 U/µL, Enzymatics) and incubate: 4 °C for 5 minutes, slow ramp to 37 °C (15s per 1 °C), 37 °C for 1.5 hours, then 4 °C hold.

steps.title: Final Library Amplification and Indexing
steps.instruction: Perform final PCR amplification with indexing primers.

substeps.instruction: Prepare AMPure buffer by pelleting beads and collecting supernatant.
Add 70 µL AMPure buffer and 50 µL water per well of a deepwell plate.
Transfer sample (with beads) to the deepwell plate, mix, and incubate at RT for 10 minutes.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, and wash twice with 80% ethanol.
Resuspend beads in 48 µL PCR master mix (containing PE1.0 primer: AATGATACGGCGACCACCGAGATCTACACTCTTTCCCTACACGACGCTCTTCCGATC*T).
Add 2 µL iTAG indexing primer (5uM; iPCRTag: CAAGCAGAAGACGGCATACGAGATXXXXXXXXGAGATCGGTCTCGGCATT CCTGCTGAACCGCTCTTCCGATC*T).
Cycle: 95 °C for 2 minutes; 14 cycles of (94 °C for 1m20s, 65 °C for 30s, 72 °C for 30s); followed by 72 °C for 3 minutes and 4 °C hold.

steps.title: Nextera XT Tagmentation and Final Pooling
steps.instruction: Perform tagmentation and final library preparation (performed outside pre-PCR room).

substeps.instruction: In a 96 or 384 well plate, add 2.25 µL Tagmentation mastermix, 0.75 µL NT buffer, 2.25 µL NPM, and 1.5 µL pre-mixed/diluted i7 and i5 primers. Vortex and centrifuge.
Add 0.75 µL of cDNA sample (100-500 pg/µL) to the mastermix, vortex, and spin down.
Incubate: 4 °C for 5 minutes, slow ramp to 37 °C (15s per 1 °C), 37 °C for 30 minutes. For the fifth round, incubate an additional 1 hour at 37 °C, then 4 °C hold.
Cycle: 72 °C for 5 minutes, 95 °C for 2 minutes; 10 cycles of (95 °C, 65 °C, 72 °C); followed by 72 °C for 5 minutes and 4 °C hold.
Pool 1 µL of each indexed cDNA library. Purify using 0.7x AMPure XP beads with 2x 80% ethanol washes.
Place on magnet, remove supernatant, wash twice with 80% ethanol, and air-dry beads for 5 minutes at RT.
Make 2 pools of 48 libraries (5 µL each) in 1.5 mL tubes.
Purify each pool with 168 µL AMPure XP beads (0.7x), 2x 80% ethanol washes, and elute in 100 µL water.
Purify each pool a second time with 70 µL AMPure XP beads (0.7x), 2x 80% ethanol washes, and elute in 100 µL water.
QC using Bioanalyzer High Sensitivity chip (expected fragment length 300-1000bp, average 450-500bp). If <200bp, perform additional 0.7x AMPure XP purification.
